title: Agent Skills Manifest
description: Configuration for agent skill fanout. Declares canonical all-skills entries and reference-only packs to compile into one scope activation root.

skillName.description: A single safe path component: lowercase alphanumerics, dot, dash, underscore. No slashes, no leading/trailing separator.

packName.description: A single safe path component naming a directory under the registry's packs/ directory.

versionComponent.description: A single safe path component naming a version directory (e.g. '6.10.2', '0.18.2', '6.10.1-next.31').

sourceUri.description: Legacy bootstrap/import source. Direct external activation bypasses the canonical all-skills catalog and is deprecated by ADR-0001.

inherit_global.description: Whether to inherit global skills and packs (only applicable for project scope). Project entries override inherited ones of the same name.

registry.description: Default Git repository registry URL for skills and packs.

packs.description: Reference-only skill compositions under packs/<name>[/<version>]. A pack selects canonical all-skills names; it never owns or materializes copied skill payloads.

anyOf.description: Shorthand for a registry pack: '<name>' or '<name>@<version>'.

name.description: The pack name. Resolves to packs/<name> in the registry unless source or registry_path is given.

version.description: Version directory under packs/<name>/. If omitted and the pack directory holds only version subdirectories, the highest version is selected.

source.description: Deprecated direct source override retained only for migration. Import the pack manifest and its member skills into the canonical registry instead.

registry.description: Git repository registry URL override for this specific pack.

registry_path.description: Explicit path to the pack within the registry (e.g. 'packs/bmad/6.10.2'). Mutually exclusive with source.

include.description: If present, only these skills from the pack are materialized.

exclude.description: Skills to skip. Applied after include.

optional.description: When true, an unresolvable pack produces a warning instead of an error.

flatten.description: Legacy copied-payload migration flag. New packs list canonical leaf names directly; flattening does not authorize pack-owned skill definitions.

sealed.description: Legacy copied-payload verification flag. Reproducibility now pins the canonical catalog and composition revisions instead of duplicating skill bytes.

skills.description: Canonical all-skills entries to synchronize. An entry here always overrides a pack member of the same name.

anyOf.description: A canonical skill name. Slash-bearing registry paths are legacy and should be imported into all-skills before activation.

name.description: The local folder name to link the skill to.

source.description: Deprecated direct source. Import the skill into all-skills and reference its canonical name instead.

version.description: Optional git branch, tag, or commit hash to checkout.

registry.description: Optional Git repository registry URL override for this specific skill.

registry_path.description: Path to the skill within the registry.
